facts.text: Validated models of site floodlights, beacons and headlights on machines were not found.

facts.text: For cameras exposed to artificial site lighting, spectral power, flicker or PWM and HDR behaviour matter.

facts.text: Ordinary visible lights have a minor effect on lidar.
facts.quote: Ordinary visible lights have minor effect on lidar

facts.text: Near-infrared or laser interference with lidar is sensor-specific.

facts.text: Validated near-infrared or laser interference models for lidar were not found.

facts.text: Radar and ultrasonic sensors are unaffected by artificial site lighting.

facts.text: For thermal cameras, site thermal sources matter more than lamps.
